body.name: SIPrograms
body.type: The admissible quasi-Markovian canonical program class of Shridharan--Iyengar.
body.def: \(\mathfrak S_{\mathrm{SI}}\) contains their finite quasi-Markovian canonical multilinear programs, and \(\mathfrak S_{\mathrm{SI}}^{\le2}\) is its at-most-quadratic exact-optimization subfamily.
